name: Sugar Service
storyline:
You and your long-time crush team up to launch a startup that combines a Rent-a-Partner service with a Camgirl Agency. It’s an unconventional business, but one rooted in trust, ambition, and the drive to build something real — even if it gets messy.

As you grow your team, you’ll meet a diverse cast of characters, each with their own stories, boundaries, and goals. You’ll juggle client satisfaction, business decisions, and personal relationships, all while learning how to balance emotional connection with financial reality.
summary: Sugar Service is an 18+, sex-positive, free-roam visual novel that mixes dating-sim elements with life-sim mechanics. Built in Ren’Py, it explores intimacy, identity, and the hustle of navigating the modern sex work industry — all through a blend of storytelling, strategy, and connection.
